title: Postcards and Wardrobe
author: Oscar Nakamura
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
